environment.description: Container orchestrated via containerd with runtime spec override. The OCI bundle spec has rootfs propagation set to 'rprivate' with the root filesystem path marked as readonly in the OCI runtime config (config.json root.readonly=true). No additional volume mounts or tmpfs overlays are defined in the mounts array — the entire visible filesystem tree from the container's mount namespace perspective has no writable backing store. The container's seccomp profile is set to the default docker profile (which still allows read syscalls). Note: the process CAN still call open() with O_RDONLY on any path the uid has permission to read; the path traversal read vector technically still resolves paths, but the sensitive target files (/etc/shadow, /proc/self/environ, /root/.ssh/*) are not present in the container image as it uses a distroless base (gcr.io/distroless/cc-debian12) which contains only the compiled binary, libc, and the /var/docs content layer.
